# volcano_storage_object (Resource)

A single file in a storage bucket, uploaded from a local file. Content changes always replace the object (the API's in-place update is a chunked resumable-upload protocol this provider does not drive); is_public can be changed in place. project_id scopes the lookup used by Read (there is no per-object metadata GET, only a project-wide search) but is not itself part of the API path.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "volcano_storage_object" "logo" {
  project_id  = volcano_project.example.id
  bucket_name = volcano_storage_bucket.avatars.name
  path        = "branding/logo.png"
  source      = "${path.module}/assets/logo.png"
  is_public   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket_name` (String)
- `path` (String) Full path within the bucket, e.g. users/abc123/avatar.png.
- `project_id` (String)
- `source` (String) Path to the local file to upload. Forces replacement if changed (content cannot be updated in place).

### Optional

- `is_public` (Boolean) If true, the object can be downloaded with just an anon key.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `etag` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `mime_type` (String)
- `public_url` (String)
- `size` (Number)
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import volcano_storage_object.logo <project-id>,<bucket-name>,<object-path>
```
